title: Rally journeys
description: Players' experience of Rally, as its README describes it to them.

entities.name: Climb the high-score table
entities.description: A player plays the computer, enters a match on the table and comes back to see it.
entities.goal: Get a name onto the public table, higher than before.

stages.context: Arrives at the game signed out.
stages.action: Signs in, and is sent back to the game.
stages.outcome: The title screen, with a match playing behind it.

stages.context: Picks a level; harder levels score more.
stages.action: Plays to 11, by two clear points.
stages.outcome: A score: 100, 200 or 300 a point, and ten points' worth for a win.

stages.action: Keeps or types a name of up to 12 characters, and saves.
stages.outcome: The table, with the new row marked and its rank.
The table, checked by replay, for anyone to see.

entities.name: Play a friend online
entities.description: Two friends, each on their own device, meet in the multiplayer lobby and play.
entities.goal: Play a friend who is somewhere else, as often as they like.

stages.context: Both are signed in to the games.
stages.action: One starts a Rally game and waits; the other joins by typing that player's address.
stages.outcome: A countdown, cut short when everyone presses Ready.

stages.context: The game opens on both devices.
stages.action: Each plays their own paddle; the scoreboard names the other.
stages.outcome: The same match on both screens; a slow connection makes the other wait, and they are told.
The lobby, ready for another game.

relatedViews.relationship: The use cases behind the journeys' stages.
